modified_caption: Ablation study on the HateXplain dataset. The line chart illustrates variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants of MS-FSLHate. The x-axis represents the 'Model Variants', labeled as nominal categories: 'Full model (Ours)', 'w/o Prompt', 'w/o Augmentation', 'w/o Attention', and 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. The y-axis represents 'Metric (%)' with a linear scale, ranging from 58 to 66, marked at intervals of 2%. The purple line, representing 'Precision,' uses circles as markers and a solid line style. It starts at approximately 65.45% with the 'Full model (Ours)' and shows a consistent decline across the variants, reaching its lowest point at 57.74% for 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. The blue line signifies 'Recall,' featuring circles and a solid line. It begins at 65.78% for 'Ours', drops sharply to 59.64% with 'w/o Prompt,' and continues to decline steadily, reaching 56.82% at 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation.' The brown line illustrates the 'F1-score' using circles and a solid line, starting at 65.16%, decreasing to 60.16% for 'w/o Prompt', and showing a slight increase at 'w/o Augmentation' before dropping again to 57.74% with 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. There is a legend on the bottom left of the plot to infer the line color from their labels.

modifications.claim: The purple line (Precision) shows a consistent decline across the variants, reaching its lowest point at 57.74% for 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'.
modifications.reality: The purple line (Precision) fluctuates across the variants, starting at 65.45%, dropping to 61.06%, rising to 62.22%, increasing further to 64.06%, and ending at 65.44%. It does not show a consistent decline nor does it reach its lowest point at 57.74%.

modifications.claim: The blue line (Recall) continues to decline steadily, reaching 56.82% at 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'.
modifications.reality: The blue line (Recall) does not decline steadily; it drops from 65.78% to 59.64%, rises to 62.63%, and then declines again to 56.82%. The trend is not steady.

modifications.claim: The brown line (F1-score) shows a slight increase at 'w/o Augmentation' before dropping again to 57.74% with 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'.
modifications.reality: The brown line (F1-score) rises from 60.16% to 62.63% at 'w/o Augmentation', but this increase is not slight—it is significant compared to the other changes in the chart.
